
```{r}
#| label: generate-analytic-data

met_data <- met_combined |>
  dplyr::group_by(fxs_sts_id) |>
  # fill in measurements only collected at baseline
  tidyr::fill(demo_age, .direction = "down") |>
  tidyr::fill(leit3_nv_iq, .direction = "down") |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Placebo", "Metformin"))
  ) |> 
  # calculate pql overall
  calculate_pql_overall()

met_baseline <- met_data |>
  dplyr::filter(redcap_event_name == "Baseline Visit (Visit 1)")

n_screened <- nrow(met_baseline)
n_screened_ucd <- met_baseline |> dplyr::filter(Site == "UCD") |> nrow()
n_screened_edm <- met_baseline |> dplyr::filter(Site == "Edmonton") |> nrow()
n_screened_stj <- met_baseline |> dplyr::filter(Site == "STJ") |> nrow()


met_baseline_screen <- met_baseline |>
  dplyr::filter(rand_inclyn == "Yes" | rand_code %in% c("1-035", "1-040"))
met_baseline_iq <- met_baseline_screen |>
  dplyr::filter(leit3_nv_iq < 85)
met_baseline_ltfu <- met_baseline_iq |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Treatment))

n_rand <- nrow(met_baseline_ltfu)

n_met <- sum(met_baseline_ltfu$Treatment == "Metformin")
n_placebo <- sum(met_baseline_ltfu$Treatment == "Placebo")

# keep those with > 1 visits
met_multi_visit <- met_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_visit = dplyr::n(),
    .by = fxs_sts_id
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(fxs_sts_id %in% met_baseline_ltfu$fxs_sts_id, n_visit > 1)

met_2visit <- met_multi_visit |>
  dplyr::filter(n_visit == 2) |>
  t()
# Manual review: 
#   FXSMET-18-2-003 and FXSMET-18-2-039 only have data for Visit 1 -> DROP
#   107413-100 has partial data for Visit 2 -> KEEP

met_analytic <- met_multi_visit |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cgis_soi_fct = dplyr::case_when(
      (cgis_soi == "1 = Normal" | 
         cgis_soi == "2 = Borderline Ill") ~ "< 3 = Normal, Borderline Ill",
      .default = cgis_soi
    ) |>
      factor(
        levels = c(
          "< 3 = Normal, Borderline Ill",
          "3 = Mildly Ill", "4 = Moderately Ill", "5 = Markedly Ill",
          "6 = Severely Ill", "7 = Among the Most Extremely Ill Patients"
        )
      ),
    cgis_soi = stringr::str_extract(cgis_soi, "[:digit:]") |> as.numeric()
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !(fxs_sts_id %in% c("FXSMET-18-2-003", "FXSMET-18-2-039"))
  )

## final data prep: create post-baseline time variables for model fitting
met_analytic <- met_analytic |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    age_group = dplyr::case_when(
      demo_age < 12 ~ "Age 6-11",
      demo_age >= 12 ~ "Age 12+"
    ) |>
      factor(levels = c("Age 6-11", "Age 12+")),
    t2 = dplyr::if_else(redcap_event_name == "Week 8 Visit (Visit 2)", 1, 0),
    t3 = dplyr::if_else(redcap_event_name == "Week 16 (Visit 3/Early Term)", 1, 0),
    t23 = dplyr::if_else(redcap_event_name == "Baseline Visit (Visit 1)", 0 , 1),
    time = dplyr::case_when(
      redcap_event_name == "Baseline Visit (Visit 1)" ~ 0,
      redcap_event_name == "Week 8 Visit (Visit 2)" ~ 8,
      redcap_event_name == "Week 16 (Visit 3/Early Term)" ~ 16
    ),
    Metformin = as.numeric(Treatment == "Metformin"),
    Placebo = as.numeric(Treatment == "Placebo"),
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = c(demo_age, leit3_nv_iq),
      ~ .x - mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .names = "{col}_center"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    lang = dplyr::if_else(
      lang == "", NA_character_, lang
    ),
    Language = dplyr::if_else(
      els_french == 0, "English", "French"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(fxs_sts_id) |>
  tidyr::fill(lang, .direction = "down") |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |> 
  # reclassify full mutation females as mosaic
  dplyr::mutate(
    Molecular.Category = dplyr::if_else(
      condition = Molecular.Category == "Full" & sex == "Female",
      true = "Mosaic",
      false = Molecular.Category
    )
  )

met_analytic_baseline <- met_analytic |>
  dplyr::filter(redcap_event_name == "Baseline Visit (Visit 1)")

n_final <- nrow(met_analytic_baseline)
n_final_ucd <- met_analytic_baseline |> dplyr::filter(Site == "UCD") |> nrow()
n_final_edm <- met_analytic_baseline |> dplyr::filter(Site == "Edmonton") |> nrow()
n_final_stj <- met_analytic_baseline |> dplyr::filter(Site == "STJ") |> nrow()

met_analytic_eng <- dplyr::filter(met_analytic, Language == "English")

met_stj <- dplyr::filter(met_analytic, Site == "STJ")

met_cols <- colnames(met_analytic)

met_analytic_ids <- met_analytic |> 
  dplyr::pull(fxs_sts_id) |> 
  unique()
```
